name: Do I need permits for a kitchen remodel in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a kitchen remodel in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will likely need permits for a kitchen remodel in Berkeley, especially if the project involves changes to the structural layout, plumbing, or electrical systems. Minor cosmetic updates typically do not require permits. We handle all necessary permit applications and ensure your remodel complies with local building codes and regulations, making the process smoother for you.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually required for kitchen remodels in Berkeley if structural, plumbing, or electrical changes are involved; we manage the permit process.
